package.digestSource: Computed from the downloaded release asset; the asset digest GitHub publishes was not compared (the GitHub REST API was unreachable from the survey environment).

companions.role: Runs the exec tool's JavaScript isolate; required by every tool scenario of the census (findings C8).

claims.notes: Run against the extracted release package: bin/codex beside bin/codex-code-mode-host. Every scenario met its declared expectations; a degraded run writes nothing to the capture directory.

claims.harness: probes/codex@0.166.0: parse-probe.mjs, config-probe.mjs, file-change-probe.mjs, history-truncation-probe.mjs, provider-mismatch-probe.mjs
claims.notes: Session-free parse and config-loader probes, root and resume help, the runtime meaning of FileUpdateChange.diff per kind, the 64 KiB command-output cap in replayed history, and the model-provider admission refusals (ModelProviderError data on thread/resume and turn/start), in isolated homes against a loopback model. The S1-S35 invocation landing and the ema_auth probe were not re-run at 0.166.0 (findings C9).

Digest-pinned exact-release source establishes the kind-dependent meaning of FileUpdateChange.diff, move suffix encoding, and deterministic path ordering; source alone does not prove runtime occurrence.

limitations: The hermetic census and the binary probes ran on linux-x64 only (the earlier census platform was darwin-arm64). darwin-arm64, darwin-x64 and windows-x64 are not acquired for this candidate; the protected workflow acquires and attests them.

The exec tool needs the package's codex-code-mode-host beside bin/codex. The artifact identity digests bin/codex; the companion digest is recorded here and in the census run, but the acquisition schema has no companion-file concept yet (findings C8).

On linux-x64 without a system bubblewrap, every app-server start sends one configWarning (Codex falls back to the bundled codex-resources/bwrap); it is a platform branch, present at 0.164.0 on the same platform, not 0.166.0 drift (findings C9).

The reviewed 0.164.0 behavior graph is retained unchanged: the 0.166.0 census reproduces every scenario's method, result and item-type sequence on the same platform; other schema-only methods remain unverified until dedicated runtime scenarios establish their ordering.
History scenarios run on one connection with the thread loaded; a cold resume from the rollout after an app-server restart is not part of the census.
